item.description: When Takuma Watanabe left Angel’s Share, a craft cocktail hub in Manhattan’s West Village, he didn’t just move on to his next gig. Instead, he set out to chase his dream. In 2022, Takuma opened the doors to Martiny’s, his Japanese-style cocktail bar in Union Square. item.title: 7 Alternatives to Chartreuse, the Perpetually Hard-to-Find Green Liqueur
item.description: With its signature bright green color and easy-to-read label, a bottle of Chartreuse isn’t hard to spot on liquor store shelves or bar racks. That is, if it’s even there.
